# Code of Conduct

We commit to a professional, respectful, and evidence-led project environment.

Participants must not harass, demean, threaten, impersonate, or expose private information about others. Technical disagreement should address the behavior, contract, evidence, or trade-off rather than the person.

Maintainers may remove content or participation that violates these expectations. Serious concerns should be reported privately to the repository owner. Enforcement decisions should be documented proportionately and protect the privacy of affected people.
